import pathlib
p = pathlib.Path('/home/hatch/workspace/.flipbook2-build/project/slotbook/service.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
p.write_text((
    '"""slotbook service layer: many salons over one engine.\n'
    '\n'
    'The engine (slotbook/engine.py) is a single book with module-level\n'
    "state - chapters 1-2's design, and deliberately so: every booking\n"
    'rule lives there exactly once. This layer is the multi-tenant\n'
    "shell around it. A Service owns any number of salons; each salon's\n"
    "book is a schema-2 snapshot (the store's currency) held by the\n"
    'service, and the engine is loaded with one salon at a time:\n'
    "activating a salon exports the outgoing salon's state back to its\n"
    'slot and imports the incoming one. Every public operation runs\n'
    'under one reentrant lock, so activation can never interleave with\n'
    "an operation, and the store's last-writer-wins file contract is\n"
    'never asked to merge anything.\n'
    '\n'
    'Salon ids are small integers handed out in creation order and\n'
    'never reused. Unknown salons refuse operations the way the engine\n'
    'refuses an invalid booking - a plain None or False - with\n'
    'salon_exists to tell "no such salon" apart from "refused".\n'
    'This module never prints; presentation lives in render.py and,\n'
    'from chapter 3, in api.py.\n'
    '"""\n'
    'import copy\n'
    'import threading\n'
    '\n'
    'from . import engine\n'
    '\n'
    '\n'
    'class Service:\n'
    '    """A multi-salon shell over the single-book engine."""\n'
    '\n'
    '    def __init__(self):\n'
    '        self._lock = threading.RLock()\n'
    '        self._salons = {}\n'
    '        self._next_salon_id = 1\n'
    '        self._active = None\n'
    '        # The blank book: whatever the engine holds right now is\n'
    '        # the template every new salon starts from. In practice\n'
    '        # the engine is pristine when a Service is constructed\n'
    "        # (process start, or a test's fresh-book fixture).\n"
    '        self._blank = engine.export_state()\n'
    '\n'
    '    # -- salon registry --------------------------------------------\n'
    '\n'
    '    def create_salon(self, name):\n'
    '        """Register a salon and return its id, or None for a\n'
    '        blank or non-string name. The salon starts as a blank\n'
    '        book; its state materializes on first activation."""\n'
    '        if not isinstance(name, str) or not name.strip():\n'
    '            return None\n'
    '        with self._lock:\n'
    '            salon_id = self._next_salon_id\n'
    '            self._next_salon_id += 1\n'
    '            self._salons[salon_id] = {"name": name.strip(),\n'
    '                                      "state": None, "tokens": {}}\n'
    '            return salon_id\n'
    '\n'
    '    def salon_exists(self, salon_id):\n'
    '        """True when ``salon_id`` names a registered salon."""\n'
    '        return salon_id in self._salons\n'
    '\n'
    '    def list_salons(self):\n'
    '        """Return [{"id": ..., "name": ...}] in id order."""\n'
    '        with self._lock:\n'
    '            return [{"id": sid, "name": self._salons[sid]["name"]}\n'
    '                    for sid in sorted(self._salons)]\n'
    '\n'
    '    def salon_name(self, salon_id):\n'
    '        """Return a salon\'s name, or None for an unknown salon."""\n'
    '        salon = self._salons.get(salon_id)\n'
    '        return salon["name"] if salon is not None else None\n'
    '\n'
    '    # More salon operations land here as chapter 3 grows.\n'
), encoding='utf-8')

    '        if not engine.import_state(state):\n'
    '            return False\n'
    '        self._active = salon_id\n'
    '        return True\n'
    '\n'
    '    def _sync(self):\n'

    '    """A background worker that delivers reminders into an outbox.\n'
    '\n'
    '    enqueue() accepts reminder dicts (from build_reminders) and\n'
    '    returns how many were new: a reminder whose (salon,\n'
    '    appointment) key was already queued or sent is refused, so\n'
    "    re-running a day's enqueue can never double-send. start()\n"
    '    spawns the thread; drain() blocks until the queue is empty\n'
    '    (queue.join), which is what makes tests deterministic - no\n'
    '    sleeps, no polling; stop() drains, then parks the thread on\n'
    '    a sentinel and joins it. The outbox is the delivery record:\n'
    '    reminder dicts in delivery order.\n'
    '    """\n'
    '\n'
    '    def __init__(self):\n'
    '        self._queue = queue.Queue()\n'
    '        self._outbox = []\n'
    '        self._seen = set()\n'
    '        self._lock = threading.Lock()\n'
    '        self._thread = None\n'
    '\n'
    '    def start(self):\n'
    '        """Start the worker thread. False when already running."""\n'
    '        with self._lock:\n'
    '            if self._thread is not None:\n'
    '                return False\n'
    '            self._thread = threading.Thread(target=self._run,\n'
    '                                            daemon=True)\n'
    '            self._thread.start()\n'
    '            return True\n'
    '\n'

    '        while True:\n'

p.write_text((
    '"""slotbook rate limiting: a fixed-window counter per key.\n'
    '\n'
    'The limiter is deliberately small and honest: each key gets\n'
    "``limit`` allowances per ``window_seconds``; a key's window\n"
    'starts at its first request and resets whole when it expires -\n'
    'no sliding windows, no token buckets, nothing to tune. The\n'
    'clock is injectable so tests advance time by assignment, never\n'
    'by sleeping. Refused calls consume nothing.\n'
    '"""\n'
    'import threading\n'
    'import time\n'
    '\n'
    '\n'
    'class RateLimiter:\n'
    '    """Fixed-window rate limiter, safe for concurrent use."""\n'
    '\n'
    '    def __init__(self, limit, window_seconds, clock=time.monotonic):\n'
    '        if limit < 1 or window_seconds <= 0:\n'
    '            raise ValueError("limit and window must be positive")\n'
    '        self._limit = limit\n'
    '        self._window = window_seconds\n'
    '        self._clock = clock\n'
    '        self._lock = threading.Lock()\n'
    '        self._hits = {}\n'
    '\n'
    '    def allow(self, key):\n'
    '        """True when ``key`` has allowance left in its current\n'
    '        window (and consumes one); False when it does not."""\n'
    '        now = self._clock()\n'
    '        with self._lock:\n'
    '            start, count = self._hits.get(key, (now, 0))\n'
    '            if now - start >= self._window:\n'
    '                start, count = now, 0\n'
    '            if count >= self._limit:\n'
    '                self._hits[key] = (start, count)\n'
    '                return False\n'
    '            self._hits[key] = (start, count + 1)\n'
    '            return True\n'
    '\n'
    '    def remaining(self, key):\n'
    '        """How many allowances ``key`` has left in its current\n'
    '        window."""\n'
    '        now = self._clock()\n'
    '        with self._lock:\n'
    '            start, count = self._hits.get(key, (now, 0))\n'
    '            if now - start >= self._window:\n'
    '                return self._limit\n'
    '            return self._limit - count\n'
), encoding='utf-8')
